**Domain**: Cross

## Definition
A next-generation reusable vehicle (e.g., NextRS) capable of sustained hypersonic flight to deliver rapid, persistent effects. Demands real-time sensor fusion and onboard neuromorphic processing for extreme-speed navigation and targeting, a key iNEST use case.
